JPG or PNG, landscape, at least 1200 by 800 pixels, up to 5 MB each. Add up to 8 photos. Use clear, well lit photos of your space and what you offer, not logos or stock images.
7

Branch redemption PIN

To redeem a voucher at this branch, a customer enters this PIN in their Redeemo app. It confirms they are at your location in person. Your staff can simply read the PIN out to the customer, so no one needs to touch the customer's phone.

This is not a secret password, but do not display it publicly or post it online, because it controls redemptions at this branch.
You can view or change this PIN any time under Branches.

Verify your business sooner

Choose your flagship voucher

This is the voucher that brings new customers through your door. Most businesses start with Buy one get one: it is the easiest for customers to understand and the strongest at bringing people in.

How Redeemo vouchers work
A quick primer before you build, so it all makes sense.
The most important rule
{{ cycleHeadline }}

{{ cycleBody }}

{{ p.text }}
In this prototype you can build Buy one, get one free, Spend & save, and Freebie. The other types are coming soon.

Create a voucher

Pick the type that fits what you want to do. Each one works a little differently, so here is what it is, how it works, and what it is best for.

How Redeemo vouchers work

Each voucher you create can be used once a month by each customer. After a customer uses one of your vouchers, it turns off for them until their next monthly cycle, when it renews and they can use it again.

So you can offer plenty of vouchers with confidence. Each one is used at most once a month per customer, which means genuine value for them and a reason to keep coming back, while you protect your margin and never give away unlimited discounts.

Two types are the exception. Time limited can be used once each time its window comes around, and Reusable can be used again on the interval you set.
